actions.reviseCancel: Cancel the edit and bring back the old version

done.submit: The notice was sent for approval.
done.pin: The notice is pinned to the home page.

mine.title: My notices
mine.description: The notices and policies that reached you from human resources and corporate communications.
mine.emptyHint: Notices and policies will appear here when they reach you.

read.title: Read the notice
read.checkbox: I have read the policy and acknowledge it and commit to it.
read.acknowledged: Your acknowledgement is recorded. Thank you.
read.archived: This notice is no longer in force.

manage.title: Manage notices
manage.description: Write notices, follow their approval and publishing, and see who acknowledged.

flow.revision_cancelled: The edit was cancelled and the old version came back

form.channelHint: Only the channels you write in are shown.
form.datePast: The publish date cannot be in the past
form.revisePublishes: The new version is published as soon as it is approved.

kindCards.policyHint: Stays in “Waiting for me” until the employee acknowledges it.

form.titleEnHint: Filled in automatically as you type.
form.bodyHint: Write the notice as the employee will see it. It does not change after publishing without a new version.
form.reachZero: This audience reaches no employee now.
form.catchUp: Whoever joins this audience after publishing gets the notice the next night. It is sent in batches.

discard.title: Discard the changes?
discard.body: What you wrote is not saved and will be lost if you close the window.

missing.date: Choose a publish date of today or later.
missing.title: Write the Arabic title.

reject.title: Reject the notice
reject.description: It goes back to its writer as a draft, with the reason.
reject.tooShort: Write a reason of at least five characters.
reject.done: The notice was rejected and went back to its writer.

delete.title: Delete the draft?
delete.body: “{{title}}” will be deleted and this cannot be undone.

archive.title: Archive the notice?
archive.body: “{{title}}” leaves “My notices” and “Waiting for me”; the report stays.

revise.title: Edit as a new version?
revise.body: The notice will be hidden from employees until the leader approves the new version.
revise.done: The notice is hidden and the edit has started.

revise-cancel.title: Cancel the edit?
revise-cancel.body: The published version comes back at once and your edit is deleted.
revise-cancel.button: Cancel the edit and bring back the old version
revise-cancel.done: The old version is visible again.

approve.title: Approve the notice?
approve.body: Approve “{{title}}”? It will be published on {{date}} to {{count}} employees.

approvals.title: Waiting for my approval
approvals.description: Notices written by your unit's employees. They are not published before you approve.
approvals.info: You approve the text, the audience and the publish date as they are. If you reject it, it goes back to its writer with the reason.
approvals.searchLabel: Search what waits for my approval
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval
approvals.emptyHint: When someone in your unit sends a notice, it will appear here.
approvals.note: You do not approve a notice you wrote: its approval goes to the leader of the unit above.

channels.pageDescription: The publishing channels of the company's units: each channel has its unit and its writers, and any unit can have one. Adding a writer gives them the writing permissions of their channel at once; removing takes them back.
channels.noWriters: There are no writers in this channel yet.
channels.removeBody: Their drafts ({{drafts}}) stay and another writer of the channel takes them over; what was sent for approval ({{pending}}) goes on.
channels.name: Channel
channels.searchChannels: Search by channel or unit name
channels.emptyHint: Add a channel for a unit so its writers can write notices and send them for their leader's approval.
channels.deleteBlocked: A channel with notices cannot be deleted; disable it instead
channels.writersExplain: Channel of the unit {{unit}}. A writer automatically gets permission to write in this channel only, and does not approve their own notice.

form.descriptionNew: A new publishing channel for a unit of the organization structure.
form.descriptionRename: The name and the writers' role change with it; the unit of the channel does not.
form.nameEnHint: Filled in automatically as you type the Arabic name; you can edit it.
form.unitHint: Only the units whose channels you manage. The unit cannot be changed after the channel is made.
form.pickUnit: Choose a unit from the list.
form.unitFixed: The unit of a channel cannot be changed after it is made.
form.info: The writers' permissions are set up automatically (one system role) and everyone you add as a writer gets them.

disable.title: Disable “{{name}}”?
disable.body: Nobody can write a new notice in it, and its writers ({{writers}}) lose their permissions at once, keeping their membership. Its published notices stay, and enabling it again gives the permissions back.

enable.title: Enable “{{name}}”?
enable.body: Its writers ({{writers}}) get their writing permissions back at once.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: The channel and its writer role are deleted and its writers ({{writers}}) lose their permissions. This cannot be undone.

addWriter.title: Add a writer
addWriter.description: Writes in the chosen channel and sends notices for the approval of their unit leader.
addWriter.employeeHint: Type the first letter of the name.
addWriter.pickFromList: Choose an employee from the list.
addWriter.info: The writer automatically gets writing permissions in this channel only, does not approve their own notice, and does not write in other channels.
addWriter.noApprover: This employee has no leader above, so a platform administrator approves their notices.
addWriter.done: {{name}} was added as a writer in the channel.

settings.title: Publishing in batches
settings.description: A notice reaches a large audience in batches that do not flood e-mail and notifications.
settings.live: An audience of {{people}} employees gets the notice in {{batches}} batches over {{minutes}} minutes.

home.title: Notices
home.noReminder: A policy stays here until you acknowledge it. We send no extra reminder.

banner.title: Reminder
banner.body: {{count}} notice(s) are waiting for your acknowledgement. Read and acknowledge them.
banner.label: Notices waiting for acknowledgement

notices-home.title: Notices on the home page
notices-home.body: Here you see what needs your attention among the notices: policies you have not acknowledged, what reached you this week, and the pinned notice the company wants everyone to see.

notices-my.title: My notices
notices-my.body: Every notice and policy that reached you in one place. Open a notice to read it; a policy stays in “Waiting for me” until you acknowledge it, and we send no extra reminder.

can.acknowledge: You acknowledge policies after reading them
can.export: You export the list of your notices

notices-manage.title: Manage notices
notices-manage.body: Here the publisher writes notices, follows their approval and publishing, and sees who acknowledged and who did not. No notice is published before the unit leader approves it.

can.create: You write a new notice in your channel
can.submit: You send the notice for your unit leader's approval
can.pin: You pin a published notice to the home page
can.revise: You edit a published notice as a new version that goes back for approval
can.ack_report: You see who acknowledged and who did not, and export the list

notices-approvals.title: Waiting for my approval
notices-approvals.body: The notices your unit's employees wrote that wait for your approval. You review the text, the audience and the publish date, then approve, or reject with a reason that goes back to the writer.

can.approve: You approve the notice and it is published on its day
can.reject: You reject it with a required reason that goes back to the writer

notices-channels.title: Publishing channels
notices-channels.body: Every unit can have publishing channels, and every channel its writers. Adding a writer gives them the writing permissions of their channel only, at once; removing takes them back. You add channels for units, disable them and set the batch size here.

can.writers: You add and remove writers in the channels of your unit
can.channels: You add a channel for a unit and rename it
can.channel_remove: You disable and enable a channel, and delete it when nothing was written in it
can.settings: You set the batch size and the gap between batches
